description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter app, which displays a welcome header, progress summary, and a list of suggested lessons. It manages data loading, user interactions, and animations related to the home screen UI.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Public interface widget representing the main home screen with welcome message, lessons overview, and navigation actions.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the dynamic data, UI states, and build logic for HomeScreen.

classes.name: _AnimatedAppear
classes.description: A widget that animates its child's opacity and position with an optional delay, used for list item animations.

classes.name: _AnimatedAppearState
classes.description: State class handling the animation controller and build logic for _AnimatedAppear.

classes.name: _LessonCardHorizontal
classes.description: Widget representing a lesson card in the horizontal lessons list, showing title, duration, progress, and interaction effects.

classes.name: _LessonCardHorizontalState
classes.description: State class managing interaction states and animations for the lesson card.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads lessons from LessonRepository and updates the state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including header, progress summary, and lessons list.

methods.name: _AnimatedAppear
methods.description: Constructor setting up delay and child widget for entrance animation.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes animations and triggers data load.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of animation controllers to free resources.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the animated appearance widget with fade and translation.

methods.name: onTap
methods.description: Callback invoked when a lesson card is tapped, navigating to lesson details.
